original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Remove the black flower brooch from jacket chest and remove both black gloves. Sleeves must be empty, with no hands. Preserve jacket, black underlayers, gray skirt and shoes exactly. Pure white seamless background, soft studio light, realistic materials, full uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, skin, anatomical body parts, visible mannequin, stand, labels, text, insets, collage or watermark. Change only the listed issues; preserve all remaining image details.
